name: Ogata Kōrin
contribution: A Japanese landscape illustrator, lacquerer, painter, and textile designer of the Rinpa School.
legacy: This person is best known for his byōbu folding screens, such as Irises and Red and White Plum Blossoms, and his paintings on ceramics and lacquerware produced by his brother Kenzan.

checks.lead: Ogata Kōrin (Japanese: 尾形光琳; 1658 – June 2, 1716) was a Japanese landscape illustrator, lacquerer, painter, and textile designer of the Rinpa School.
